claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament runs from April 9 to April 12.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
All times in the 2026 Masters TV schedule are Eastern.
Round 1 has ESPN coverage from 3-7:30 p.m. ET.
Round 1 has Prime Video exclusive early coverage from 1-3 p.m. ET.
Round 1 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET.
Round 1 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 7:30-9:30 p.m. ET.
Round 2 has ESPN coverage from 3-7:30 p.m. ET.
Round 2 has Prime Video exclusive early coverage from 1-3 p.m. ET.
Round 2 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET.
Round 2 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 7:30-9:30 p.m. ET.
Round 3 has CBS coverage from 2-7 p.m. ET.
Round 3 has Paramount+ coverage from noon-2 p.m. ET.
Round 3 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
Round 3 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 7-9 p.m. ET.
Round 4 has CBS coverage from 2-7 p.m. ET.
Round 4 has Paramount+ coverage from noon-2 p.m. ET.
Round 4 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
Round 4 has Golf Channel Live From The Masters coverage from 7-9 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups coverage is available from 9:15 a.m.-7:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com/App/Paramount+ on Thursday and Friday.
Amen Corner coverage is available from 10:45 a.m.-6 p.m. ET on Masters.com/App/Paramount+ on Thursday and Friday.
Holes 15 & 16 coverage is available from 11:45 a.m.-7 p.m. ET on Masters.com/App/Paramount+ on Thursday and Friday.
On the Range coverage is available from 8:30-10:30 a.m. ET on Masters.com/App/Paramount+ on Thursday and Friday.
Early round streaming starts at 8:45 a.m. ET on Masters.com.
Paramount+ requires a premium subscription for CBS simulcasts.
